description.description: 1-2 plain-English sentences explaining what is wrong with this specific snippet.

remediation.description: A concrete, actionable fix — ideally naming the specific function/pattern to use instead.

isFalsePositive.description: true if the snippet, on closer reading, is NOT actually vulnerable (e.g. it already uses a parameterized query, escaping, or sanitizer the static rule couldn't see).

confidence.description: How confident the model is in this assessment, given it only sees this isolated snippet and not the whole file.
